body.x: Skyworth(www.iskyworth.com), a maker of TVs and a wide range of consumer electronics devices based in China, displayed "Stream TV," equipped with Ultra-D Glasses-Free 3D 4K screen, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Stream TV's breakthrough Ultra-D technology is the only proprietary glasses-free 3D solution that delivers both a stunning visual display as well content conversion from any 2D or 3D source. Ultra-D's patented hardware, middleware and sophisticated-software algorithms visually transport viewers into an unrivaled real-world 3D experience with adjustable depth that consumers can customize to their liking.Ultra-D technology is adaptable to panels of nearly any type and size. It is compatible with touch screen features as well. So, consumers can have a seamless experience with virtually any device – televisions, tablets, smartphones, portable game players, laptops, all-in-one computers and more – with resolutions up to 2160p."We are excited to add Skyworth to the Ultra-D family," says Mathu Rajan, CEO of Stream TV Networks. "With a brand value of nearly $6 billion, they've achieved the kind of success that makes them a perfect partner, both in China and across the globe."Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
